name: hovercard1
title: Image Hover Card
blurb: Image card with expandable button overlay on hover.
description: A rounded image card with title badge and an icon button at bottom-right. Button expands horizontally to show 'Visit' text on hover.
use_when: Portfolio items, project showcases, or image galleries where subtle action reveals guide user engagement.
avoid_when: Touch-only interfaces where expanded button states might persist unexpectedly.
a11y: Image has alt text; button is interactive and keyboard accessible. Expand animation is visual feedback only.
